script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you loud and clear. Right now, Mercury sits in your sixth House of daily routines, squaring your ruling fire planet Mars in the twelfth, firing up hidden stress and restless sleep. This Aries fire element means your usual courage can quickly turn into impatience. For love, if single, this tense square makes you crave intensity but drains real connection, so let tenderness build before passion ignites. If taken, watch for stubborn power struggles in your seventh House of partnership. Your fuse is short, but choose words like a diplomat. For career and money, Mercury also presses your tenth House of career authority, so don't force a bold move before your big presentation; risk feels louder than strategy. Avoid burnout bravado, because an unexpected opportunity may arrive through quiet channels. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
